name: @solncebro/market-data-feeder
description: On-demand market-data feeder: one exchange connection, fans klines/MA/24h-volume out to multiple strategy apps over a local WebSocket channel

scripts.build: yarn lint && yarn test && rm -rf dist && tsc
scripts.deploy:binance: yarn build && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'mkdir -p /opt/market-data-feeder-binance/' && rsync --archive --compress --delete .env.binance dist package.json yarn.lock node_modules root@82.26.198.214:/opt/market-data-feeder-binance/ && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'cd /opt/market-data-feeder-binance && mv .env.binance .env'
scripts.deploy: yarn build && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'mkdir -p /opt/market-data-feeder-bybit/' && rsync --archive --compress --delete .env.bybit dist package.json yarn.lock node_modules root@82.26.198.214:/opt/market-data-feeder-bybit/ && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'cd /opt/market-data-feeder-bybit && mv .env.bybit .env'
scripts.deploy:all: yarn build && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'mkdir -p /opt/market-data-feeder-binance /opt/market-data-feeder-bybit' && rsync --archive --compress --delete .env.binance dist package.json yarn.lock node_modules root@82.26.198.214:/opt/market-data-feeder-binance/ && rsync --archive --compress --delete .env.bybit dist package.json yarn.lock node_modules root@82.26.198.214:/opt/market-data-feeder-bybit/ && ssh root@82.26.198.214 'cd /opt/market-data-feeder-binance && mv .env.binance .env && cd /opt/market-data-feeder-bybit && mv .env.bybit .env'
